description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the sketch to image workflow: develop an owned sketch into a finished illustration. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_sketch_to_image with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_sketch_to_image.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery

name: chargen_quote_recipe_sketch_to_image
title: Quote sketch to image
